_readme: Every record the system keeps, one name each, and how they link. A record is one JSON file at brands/<brand>/records/<record>/<id>.json. Each id starts with its record's prefix; a link field holds another record's id, so any result traces back to the brief, offer and brand that made it. records.py checks a file against this list. Field types: text, number, date, url, list, object, id:<record>, ids:<record>, one-of:<a|b|c>. A trailing ? marks a field that may be empty.

brand.means: A business the system works for

offer.means: What the brand sells in one deal: product, price, promise, guarantee

page.means: One page a buyer sees. The shape every page record shares

presell-page.means: The page before the offer: an advertorial, quiz or story

offer-page.means: The page that sells the offer

post-purchase-page.means: Upsells and thank-you after the buy

funnel.means: The pages an ad sends a buyer through, in order

research.means: What the buyers say and want, with every quote's source

ad-brief.means: What one ad must say and do, before anyone makes it

organic.means: A brief written as a native post: a proven organic format, light product

dr.means: A brief written as a direct-response ad: hook, problem, proof, offer, ask

creator.means: A brief written for a creator to film

ad.means: One finished ad, and the results it earns
ad.written_by: video-edit, image-edit, naming, meta-upload; results by winners

email.means: One email, and what it earned

text.means: One text message, and what it earned

session.means: One working session by anyone, in any tool: what it made and what it learned
session.written_by: every tool, at the end of a session

loops.name: Ad loop
loops.feeds: winners ranks ads by results; the top ones go back into the next ad-brief

loops.name: Funnel loop
loops.feeds: each record carries the offer and funnel it sold, so revenue traces to the page and the offer

loops.name: Session loop
loops.feeds: each learning names the component or prompt it applies to; that component's owner path takes it in
